to.description: The one participant this signal is for. The host forwards it there and nowhere else.

kind.description: An SDP offer or answer, or one ICE candidate. `reset`: the sender's connections to `to` are new (its panel was rebuilt); close yours and negotiate afresh. `stereo`: what the sender's video is (VPX's VR preview on one eye or both).

sdp.description: The session description; present on offer and answer.

candidate.description: The browser's candidate line; empty for end-of-candidates.

stereo.description: Present on stereo: `sbs` = left eye | right eye side by side, `mono` = one picture, null = the sender does not know (the receiver guesses from the picture's shape).

eyes.description: Optional on stereo `sbs`: the geometry of [left, right] as the sender rendered them (the OpenXR layer camera, D7.5). Absent or null: a screen capture; the receiver assumes its own eyes.

fov.description: The view's field of view in radians, OpenXR's order and signs: [angleLeft, angleRight, angleUp, angleDown].

rect.description: The crop taken inside the view's render: [x, y, width, height], y from the top.

render.description: The view's render size (its imageRect): [width, height].

items.description: One eye of a sender whose picture comes from the OpenXR layer camera (D7.5): how it was rendered and cropped.

channel.description: Which peer connection between the two the signal belongs to: `rtc` (absent = `rtc`), the Electron connection that carries voice (and video until D10.7); `video`, the native video helper's connection for the same pair (castcade-video.exe, D10). A peer that does not run the helper ignores `video` signals.

description: any -> `to`, through the host: it forwards the frame to `to` only, `from` preserved. Sets up the peer-to-peer video and voice between two participants; never logged, never trusted for anything but media.
